newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tens of thousands of Rwanda refugees change course.
newsitem.headline: Tens of thousands of Rwanda refugees change course.

text.p: Tens of thousands of Rwandan refugees turned around in northwest Tanzania on Friday and could be heading back into Rwanda.

Reuters correspondent David Fox, on the Tanzanian side of the border with Rwanda, said he could see tens of thousands of refugees heading towards the border but they could still turn into the camps they had left earlier on Friday and on Thursday.
Fox said the stream of refugees turned around shortly after Tanzanian troops and police blocked the road to the southeast.
He said part of the mass of refugees, which he estimated at over 100,000, was five km (three miles) short of the border.

"A huge mass has just turned round, tens of thousands. They are heading north towards the border and Benaco camp. It is an absolutely incredible sight," said a spokeswoman for the U.N. World Food Programme.
